title: Prism
heroBody: Share a picture or take one, and Prism redraws it in every Mriia material at once: glow, ink, smoke, thread, sand… The scene stays; only its substance changes.
readyHint: Pick night or day and split it
ownHint: Describe the substance the scene should be made of — Prism draws the fox in it, then every picture you give it.
stylePromptPh: coloured glass with dark lead lines, light shining through
foxHint: Draw the fox first — it shows what the style will be
foxReady: Here is your style. Like it? Save it
styleSaved: Style saved — it joins every prism
signInToSave: Sign in on the profile to keep your styles on every device
primeReason: The camera takes a frame for Prism to split into materials
primePrivacy: Only the frame you take goes to the server
eBusy: Too many people right now — some styles did not make it, try again
eRate: Too many requests, wait a minute
eSignIn: Sign in on the profile to draw
eFailed: That did not work, try again
eFull: 24 styles already — delete one to add another
profTagline: Share a picture and it appears in every Mriia material at once. Your own styles stay with you.
installDesc: Opens like an app and takes pictures from your gallery
installIosHint: In Safari: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
installGenericHint: In the browser menu choose Install or Add to Home Screen.
